manifest.name: dsh-git-branch
manifest.description: DSH 插件：在对话框工具行、权限选择框右侧只读显示当前项目的 git 分支；目录不是仓库时不显示。
manifest.author: helloHupc

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch layer: one Host row. The row's module half exports both the
# Host plugin (index.js) and the browser bundle (client.js, exported as
# "./client"), so a single entry carries the branch route and the badge.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-git-branch
      name: 'dsh-git-branch'

readme.text:
[](LICENSE)
[](#安装)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的**对话框
（composer）工具行**中，紧跟在**权限选择框**之后，显示当前项目的 **git 分支**。

刻意做成只读：只显示，不提供任何选择。目录不是 git 仓库时**什么都不渲染**——没有占位、
没有空框、没有报错。

对话框工具行的固定布局：

```
[+ 命令] [权限 ▾] [plan] ← 分支标记渲染在这里
```

插件注册到 `conversation.input.left`，即 shell 紧跟在常驻模式控件之后渲染的**追加式**槽位。
该槽位对宿主 UI 是追加式的（`replaceRisk: none`），因此既不会替换也不会遮挡任何自带控件。

样式刻意对齐相邻的权限选择框：同样 28px 高、13px/500 字号、`--dsw-alias-label-secondary`
文字色、无自带背景、14px 的 `currentColor` 图标——浅色与深色主题下都落在同一基线上。分支名
过长时省略号截断，不会把右侧控件挤走。

| 目录状态 | 渲染内容 | 悬浮提示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 在某个分支上 | 分支图标 + `main` | `Git 分支: main` |
| 游离 HEAD | 分支图标 + `a1b2c3d` | `游离 HEAD: a1b2c3d` |
| 仓库还没有第一次提交 | 分支图标 + 默认分支名 | `Git 分支: main` |
| 不在仓库里 | 什么都不渲染 | — |

重新读取的时机：会话工作目录变化、每轮对话结束、标签页重新可见。**从不轮询。**

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 或更新。
- Host 进程的 `PATH` 上有 `git`。
- 别无其它：没有构建步骤、没有运行期依赖、没有配置项。

`git` 不存在或探测超过 5s 超时时，该目录会被判为“非仓库”，标记保持隐藏，不会向用户报错。

本包是一个 DSH **bundle**：自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，所以安装它的同时就会加上它的插件行。

**推荐——走插件管理器。** 在 Web 界面 Settings → Plugins → *添加插件*，目标填
`https://github.com/helloHupc/dsh-git-branch` 或本地 checkout 目录。Agent 侧等价的做法是用
`plugin_manager` 工具的 `install_bundle`，`target` 同样是该 URL 或目录。

**本地 checkout 安装。** clone 之后，用上面任一方式安装该目录。

安装是持久改动：对该 profile 下的所有会话生效，重启后依然存在。

> 目前端到端验证过的是**从本地目录安装**；从仓库 URL 安装走的是插件管理器有文档的 git 支持。

在同一个 Plugins 页面移除该 bundle，或用 `plugin_manager` 工具的 `remove_bundle`。依赖与
bundle 选择会一起移除；插件的插件行和它的路由也随之消失。

**Host 一半（`index.js`）** 在 Web 载体上注册一条只读路由：

```
GET /dsh-git-branch?sessionId=<id>&cwd=<绝对路径>
```

- 工作目录取 Host 会话存储里该 Session 的**权威 cwd**；只有当 Host 尚未物化该会话时，才使用
  客户端传来的绝对 `cwd`。**绝不**把 Host 进程自己的工作目录当作答案。
- 每次探测只用系统 `git` 跑一次（`execFile`；无 shell、无第三方库、无缓存），形式为
  `git -C <cwd> …`，并设置 `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`、`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`、5s 超时，同时
  删除 git 自己的仓库覆盖变量（`GIT_DIR`、`GIT_WORK_TREE` 等）——即便 Host 是在另一个 git
  上下文里启动的，也始终由 `-C` 决定是哪个仓库。
- 仓库判据依次为 `rev-parse --show-toplevel`、`symbolic-ref --short HEAD`，游离 HEAD 时再用
  `rev-parse --short HEAD`。`symbolic-ref` 在“还没有任何提交”的 unborn HEAD 上也能回答，而
  `rev-parse HEAD` 此时已经失败。
- 围栏与 `/api` 网关完全一致：`Host` 必须是回环地址，或部署声明的 `trustedHosts` 之一；拒绝
  `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`；带 `Origin` 时主机名必须一致。这是 DNS rebinding 与跨站读取
  的防线，不是身份认证。

一切格式正确的请求都返回 `200` + `{ ok: true, … }`，包括 `{ "isRepo": false }` —— 隐藏标记
是客户端的决定，不是错误分支。只有围栏（403）、非 GET 方法（405）和 URL 畸形（400）才返回其它
状态。

**浏览器一半（`client.js`）** 是浏览器产物：一个 classic script，只注册一个惰性 factory——这
正是 DSH 模块加载器要求的形态。它只用自己写的 React 与主题 token，不 import 任何
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 包：那些包说变就变，而一个抛异常的组件会把这个槽位条目整个变空。
样式、词典、槽位注册全部登记为 `ctx.effect`，所以插件卸载与 HMR 重新激活都能干净地移除并重装。

插件列表里的标题与描述来自 `locale/<语言>.json` 的 `meta.title` / `meta.description`，
**不是** `package.json` 的 `name`：

- `locale/en.json` 是必需的回退锚点；同目录下的其它文件（如 `zh.json`）会一起被读取。
- 标题与图标都经过包的 `exports` 解析，所以 `"./locale/*.json"` 这条导出必须保留。
- `package.json` 的 `name` 是标识符：它决定 Loader 行 `name` 与浏览器模块 id。

```bash
node test/host.test.mjs   # Host 一半的检查：围栏、方法、工作目录、git 探测
```

`test/host.test.mjs` 会创建真实的临时仓库并直接驱动注册的路由处理器——不需要 profile、不需要
安装 DSH、不联网，只要求有 `git`。

改两半的生效范围不同：

| 文件 | 生效时机 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js`、`locale/*.json` | 下次页面加载 |
| `index.js` | DSH 重启之后——Host 代码不会在进程内热替换 |

- 这条路由会通过本地 HTTP 载体暴露某个仓库的分支名。围栏阻止的是敌意页面的跨站读取；把服务绑到
  非回环地址时，请按对待任何本地服务的标准对待它。
- 客户端的 `cwd` 只接受绝对路径，且仅在会话存储没有答案时使用。路由从不回退到 Host 进程的工作
  目录，因此无法被引导去报告一个无关的仓库。
- 只读：每次调用都只是 `rev-parse` / `symbolic-ref` 探测。不写文件、不加锁、不用凭据、不弹提示。

- 每个请求一次 `git` 子进程；`git` 缺失或探测超时都会被判为“非仓库”。
- 这条路由不做身份认证，这一点与本地 Web 载体的其余部分同一设计。
- 已针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证。浏览器一半只使用该槽位有文档的标准 props，但未来的 DSH 版本仍
  有可能改动那个槽位。

[](LICENSE)
[](#install)

Shows the **git branch** of the current project in the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) composer tool
row, immediately after the permission control.

Read-only by design: it displays, it offers no choice. Outside a git repository it renders
nothing at all — no placeholder, no empty chip, no error.

English | [中文](README.md)

The composer tool row is laid out as:

```
[+ commands] [permission ▾] [plan] ← the branch marker renders here
```

The plugin registers into `conversation.input.left`, the additive slot the shell renders
right after the resident mode controls. That slot is additive for host UI
(`replaceRisk: none`), so the plugin neither replaces nor covers a built-in control.

The marker deliberately copies the metrics of the permission control beside it — 28px tall,
13px/500 text in `--dsw-alias-label-secondary`, no background of its own, a 14px
`currentColor` icon — so it sits on the same baseline in light and dark themes. A long
branch name ellipsizes instead of pushing the trailing controls.

| Directory state | What renders | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- |
| On a branch | branch icon + `main` | `Git branch: main` |
| Detached HEAD | branch icon + `a1b2c3d` | `Detached HEAD: a1b2c3d` |
| Repository with no commit yet | branch icon + the default branch name | `Git branch: main` |
| Outside a repository | nothing | — |

It re-reads when the session's working directory changes, when a turn finishes, and when the
tab becomes visible again. It never polls.

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer.
- `git` on the `PATH` of the Host process.
- Nothing else: no build step, no runtime dependencies, no configuration.

If `git` is missing, or a probe exceeds its 5s timeout, the directory is reported as "not a
repository" and the marker stays hidden. There is no user-facing error.

This package is a DSH **bundle**: it ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, so installing it also
adds its plugin row.

**Recommended — through the plugin manager.** In the Web UI, Settings → Plugins → *Add
plugin*, pointed at `https://github.com/helloHupc/dsh-git-branch` or at a local checkout. An
agent can do the same with the `plugin_manager` tool and `install_bundle`, whose `target` is
that same URL or directory.

**From a local checkout.** Clone the repository and install that directory by either route
above.

Installation is persistent: it applies to every session in the profile and survives a
restart.

> The local-checkout install is the path verified end to end so far; the repository-URL
> install uses the plugin manager's documented git support.

Remove the bundle from the same Plugins page, or call the `plugin_manager` tool with
`remove_bundle`. That drops the dependency and the bundle selection together; the plugin's
row and its route go with it.

**Host half (`index.js`)** registers one read-only route on the Web carrier:

```
GET /dsh-git-branch?sessionId=<id>&cwd=<absolute path>
```

- The working directory is the session's authoritative `cwd` from the Host session store. A
  client-supplied absolute `cwd` is used only when the Host has not materialized that session
  yet. The Host process's own working directory is never an answer.
- Each probe shells out to the system `git` once (`execFile`; no shell, no library, no cache)
  as `git -C <cwd> …`, with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`, `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, a 5s timeout,
  and git's own repository-override variables (`GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`, …) removed — so
  `-C` is always what selects the repository, even when the Host was launched inside another
  git context.
- Repository detection runs `rev-parse --show-toplevel`, then `symbolic-ref --short HEAD`,
  then `rev-parse --short HEAD` when HEAD is detached. `symbolic-ref` answers on an unborn
  HEAD, where `rev-parse HEAD` already fails.
- The route is fenced exactly like the `/api` gateway: `Host` must be loopback or a
  `trustedHosts` authority the deployment declared, `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` is refused,
  and an attached `Origin` must name the same hostname. This is a DNS-rebinding and
  cross-site defense, not authentication.

Every well-formed request answers `200` with `{ ok: true, … }`, including
`{ "isRepo": false }` — hiding the marker is the client's decision, not an error path. Only
the fence (403), a non-GET method (405), and a malformed URL (400) answer otherwise.

**Client half (`client.js`)** is the browser artifact: a classic script that registers one
lazy factory, which is the shape the DSH module loader requires. It is plain React and theme
tokens only — it imports no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` package, because those change without
notice and a throwing component would blank the slot entry. Styles, dictionaries, and the
slot registration are all `ctx.effect` registrations, so plugin unload and HMR re-activation
remove and reinstall them cleanly.

The title and description in the plugin list come from `locale/<language>.json`
(`meta.title` / `meta.description`), **not** from `package.json`'s `name`:

- `locale/en.json` is the required fallback anchor; other files in the same directory (such
  as `zh.json`) are read alongside it.
- Both the title and the icon resolve through the package `exports`, so the
  `"./locale/*.json"` entry must stay.
- `package.json`'s `name` is an identifier: it decides the Loader row `name` and the browser
  module id.

```bash
node test/host.test.mjs   # checks: fence, method, working directory, git probes
```

`test/host.test.mjs` builds real temporary repositories and drives the registered route
handler directly — no profile, no DSH install, no network. Only `git` is required.

Editing the two halves has different reach:

| File | Takes effect |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js`, `locale/*.json` | On the next page load |
| `index.js` | After a DSH restart — Host code is not hot-replaced in-process |

- The route discloses a repository's branch over the local HTTP carrier. The fence stops a
  hostile page from reading it cross-origin; treat a non-loopback bind as you would any
  other local service.
- `cwd` is accepted from the client only as an absolute path, and only when the session store
  has no answer. The route never falls back to the Host process's working directory, so it
  cannot be steered into reporting an unrelated repository.
- Read-only: every invocation is a `rev-parse` or `symbolic-ref` probe. No writes, no lock
  files, no credentials, no prompts.

- One `git` subprocess per request; a missing `git` or an over-timeout probe is reported as
  "not a repository".
- The route is unauthenticated, by the same design as the rest of the local Web carrier.
- Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The client half uses only the slot's documented standard
  props, but a future DSH release could rename that slot.
